verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.2: Take the heads of the children of Khat from among the children of Levi, and give them to their families, so that they may return to their homes.
verses.3: From the age of thirty and above, until the age of fifty, everyone who came to the assembly did their work in the tent of meeting.
verses.4: This is the service of the children of Koth in the holy tent of the Most Holy One.
verses.5: And Aaron and his sons came to the tent of meeting. They took down the coverings from the altar, and covered it with the skins of animals.
verses.6: And they put a covering over it, and they spread a cloth over it. Then they placed it in its proper place.
verses.7: And on the sides of the table, they will spread out cloth. They will also place there the containers, the cups, and the other utensils. And on top of it, they will put the bread that is meant to be kept fresh.
verses.8: And they spread a second layer of cloth over them, and covered them with a covering made of woven threads. Then they put their heads under that covering.
verses.9: And they took a covering for the lampstand, and covered it with its wicks, its branches, its frames, and all its other parts that were used to support it.
verses.10: And we gave her and all her possessions to the king of Ur-Tachsh. And we placed them on the throne.
verses.11: And over the golden altar, they shall spread a cloth, and cover it with a covering made of gold. Then they shall place their hands on it.
verses.12: And they took all the utensils with which they served in the holy place. They gave them to Beged Tchekel, and he covered them with a cover made of leather. Then they placed them on the altar.
verses.13: And they repaired the altar, and spread a cloth over it.
verses.14: And they placed all those things on it that were used for offering sacrifices: the offerings, the incense, and all the other items needed for worship. They spread them out over it like a covering, and they placed them in the sanctuary.
verses.15: And all of Aaron and his sons were used to cover the Holy Things and all that belonged to the Holy Things during the journey from Egypt. After that, the sons of Kohath sent them away to take them away from there. But they couldn’t reach the Holy Things, and they died in the tent of meeting.
verses.16: And the offerings for Eleazar, son of Aaron, the priest, who is the one who handles the lamps and the utensils used for offering sacrifices. Also, all those things that are used in the consecration of things holy, and everything that is inside them.
verses.17: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.18: Do not destroy the utensils that belong to my family from among the treasures.
verses.19: And so they did. They lived, and they did not die when they entered the holy place of the holy ones, Aaron and his sons. Each person was placed in its own place according to their duties and responsibilities.
verses.20: And they did not come to see the Holy One dead.
verses.21: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.22: Take the heads of the children of Gershon also, and bring them back to their parents’ homes, as part of their families.
verses.23: From the age of thirty years upward, until the age of fifty years, all those who come into the world shall serve as slaves in the temple.
verses.24: This is the work of the Levites, who are responsible for serving and carrying burdens.
verses.25: And they took off the curtains of the tent, as well as the covering from the altar. They also removed the coverings from above it. Then they opened the door of the altar.
verses.26: And they took away the tools and utensils used for building the house. They also took away the doors that led to the gates of the house, as well as everything related to their work. They did all those things that were necessary for their work.
verses.27: According to Aaron and his sons, all the duties of the descendants of the Gibeonites shall be carried out by them for all their masters and servants. They shall also be responsible for overseeing all their tasks.
verses.28: This is the duty of the wives of the sons of Gershunim, to keep watch in the sanctuary and to be under the care of Itamar ben Ahron, the priest.
verses.29: The sons of Merari shall be assigned to their families, to their ancestral homes. They will be settled there.
verses.30: From the age of thirty and above, until the age of fifty, all those who come to serve in the Temple must carry out their duties there.
verses.31: And this is to be kept by the priests for all their offerings in the tent of meeting, as well as in its chambers, pillars, and altars.
verses.32: And the doors of the courtyard, its posts, and its windows, as well as all its structures, were all under the care of them. They took care of everything related to the maintenance of the building.
verses.33: This is the service of the sons of Merari for all their services, in the Tabernacle, under the care of Itamar, son of Aaron, the priest.
verses.34: Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation took possession of the land for their families and for their ancestral homes.
verses.35: From the age of thirty years up to the age of fifty years, everyone who comes to serve in the temple must do so.
verses.36: And their number was seven thousand and fifty.
verses.37: These are the decrees of the priests. They were all appointed to serve in the Tabernacle. These decrees were established by Moses and Aaron, according to Jehovah’s command, through Moses’ hands.
verses.38: And the duties of the sons of Gershon for their families and for their fathers’ houses.
verses.39: From the age of thirty and up, until the age of fifty, everyone who comes to serve in the Temple must do so there.
verses.40: And their number was twelve hundred and sixty-three.
verses.41: These are the commands given by Moses and Aaron, according to Jehovah’s will, to all those who serve in the Tabernacle.
verses.42: And the duties of the descendants of Merari shall be for their own families, in their own homes.
verses.43: From the age of thirty years up to the age of fifty years, everyone who comes to serve in the Temple must do so.
verses.44: And their number was three thousand and two hundred.
verses.45: These are the commands given by Moses and Aaron, according to God’s will, in Moses’ hands.
verses.46: All those who governed Moses and Aaron, and the leaders of Israel, when they distributed the land to its families and to their ancestral homes.
verses.47: From the age of thirty years up to the age of fifty years, everyone who comes to do any kind of work or labor must do so in the Temple of God.
verses.48: Their dimensions were thousands of cubits, and five thousand cubits.
verses.49: According to Jehovah’s command, Moses punished each person according to their actions and their sins. This was what Jehovah commanded Moses to do.
